projectEstimator.title: What does your website need?
projectEstimator.lead: Answer a few simple questions about your business. You’ll get a clear recommendation and price indication—no technical knowledge required.

leads.label: Get more inquiries or customers
leads.body: Explain your offer and guide visitors towards contact or a quote.

show-work.label: Show my work or projects

sell.label: Sell products online

unsure.label: I’m not sure yet

custom.label: Unique to my brand

showcase.label: Bold and interactive

summary.label: Project estimate // CPWD
